text:
Maya K: idea — a tight, 30m "Mini Labs" webinar: rapid experiments teams can run to cut inference cost by 20% in a week. target: infra+product engineers. thoughts? :bulb:
Noah L: love it. small scope = high conversion. i can demo a 6-step batching/caching experiment + before/after numbers (8m).
Priya S: i can run a short A/B quantization test case and show quality delta + perf (7m). one slide each.
Maya K: need a host/moderator to keep pace and field chat. Ben R volunteer?
Ben R: happy to host and do intros. also can surface a 90-second customer clip.
Maya K: perfect. Sara M any customer who can do a 2min clip?
Sara M: yes — Acme infra lead agreed to a short 90s video and a screenshot of metrics. i'll collect assets.
Maya K: run-of-show (draft):
```
0:00 - Welcome & context (Ben, 2m)
0:02 - Mini Lab 1: batching + cache experiment (Noah, 8m)
0:10 - Mini Lab 2: quantize A/B (Priya, 7m)
0:17 - Customer clip + quick takeaways (Sara, 3m)
0:20 - Live lightning Q&A (Ben + panel, 9m)
0:29 - Next steps & CTA (Maya, 1m)
```
Carlos T: suggestion — include a single-slide checklist we can share after the event (1 pager: steps, expected gains, things to measure). i'll take that.
Maya K: good call. assets: hero image, 1 checklist PDF, 2 social cards, 1 annotated benchmark png. Priya can export charts; Noah annotate.
Priya S: exporting A/B charts today.
Noah L: will annotate and write captions for social.
Maya K: abstracts: we need two variants for page/email — "engineer-labs" copy and "product-impact" copy. short bullets: 3 takeaways max. Priya, can you draft both?
Priya S: on it. will post in thread by EOD.
Maya K: rehearsal windows: tech check + script run (7 days prior) and full dress (24h prior). availability: Mon 11/20 09:00-09:45, Wed 11/22 16:00-16:45. confirm.
Noah L: can do Mon.
Priya S: Wed better for me.
Ben R: both ok.
Sara M: Mon only.
Carlos T: Wed only.
Maya K: ops-bot — tentatively reserve both slots and send calendar to participants.
ops-bot: reserved Mon 1716008000 and Wed 1716184800 in #webinar-calendar; invites sent. :white_check_mark:
Maya K: registration funnel: gating — email + company role. post-event flow: watch->attendee -> score (behavioral rules) -> trigger demo outreach or nurture. Ben, can you map routing?
Ben R: will draft routing rules: attend>=30m -> SDR outreach, questions about infra -> product-marketing followup, download checklist -> nurture sequence. i'll share a diagram.
Maya K: timeline & action items: speakers upload slides (16:9) + 3 bullets by Fri (1716009000). checklist draft by Carlos by Tue (1716015000). Sara deliver clip by Thu (1716090000).
Noah L: noted, slides by Fri.
Priya S: noted.
Sara M: clip ETA Thu, will confirm today.
Maya K: final note — keep slides minimal text, prefer demos or screenshots. we'll keep Q&A lightning and push unanswered q's into a followup doc. thanks team!
